structural_change: KV-PVFIN-1 11-13: new core (lane slice of qkd_pv_fin_s). The unsliced pvfin_h3 build (epyc7 kvhubc-core1, 11-12) failed post-place setup -448 ps / CTS -381 ps on out_epoch[3] and ~20k endpoints: the calendar slots were 16-bit window compares of age + 1 against adder-derived ages, ANDed into the fault check, the state enables and the 16,384 sbuf enables, and the multiplier operands came through a 32:1 read mux. R-RTL-5 (1)+(2)+(3): calendar decoded flop to flop behind a +1 input stage (s8c: the raw-pin decode sat behind the 487 ps link-budget input delay, post-CTS -304 ps at cq_bad / cq_em), out_beat / out_epoch enabled without the fault cone, sbuf a flat vector (s8a: an inferred memory moved the 32:1 read mux behind the address flop, -480 ps), slots are flag registers (set/clear by equality), beat indices are 5-bit counters, the sbuf read and head select are prefetched one edge early into operand registers with a write-through bypass. Outline 207.36 W x 198.72 H (R-CAP-2: 17.7k um2 std after place / ~39.5k um2 core = ~0.45; the planned 190.08 frame would sit at ~0.51). Height 198.72 so the abutted lo/hi pair (397.44) fits the hub_C pocket between ft21 (y 839.3) and the die island (y 1270.8) with the 10.8 um clearance of hubc_split_form.py; the 207.36-square s8d build (signed off) did not fit (414.72).
